title: check.ts reuses the shared gitIgnoredEntries walker instead of its private copy
description: LCLI-597 added walkUnignoredMarkdown and a shared gitIgnoredEntries in src/commands/discover.ts, running the same git ls-files query as check.ts private gitIgnoredEntries. It was duplicated only because check.ts was owned by other open work (LCLI-606) at the time. Until check.ts switches to the shared helper, agents-governance discovery and lore check must be changed together, or they disagree about which files exist.

acceptanceCriteria.text: src/commands/check.ts uses the shared helper from src/commands/discover.ts and its private copy is deleted
A test pins that lore check and lore agents discovery skip the same git-ignored files
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0

implementationNotes: Implemented on chore/LCLI-610-shared-ignore-walker. src/commands/check.ts private gitIgnoredEntries is deleted; expandRoot imports the one copy from src/commands/discover.ts, which carries the fuller LCLI-379 doc comment and now names both callers. Test test/check.test.ts "lore check and lore agents discovery skip the same git-ignored files, from one shared helper (LCLI-610)": an ignored drafts/ dir and an ignored scratch.md are absent from walkUnignoredMarkdown, check exits 0 with fileCount equal to the discovered count, and a positive control (un-ignoring them) makes both walks see them and check exit 6. Mutation: making check ignore nothing turns exactly this test and the two LCLI-379 tests red. Gates: bun test 3825 pass / 0 fail, bun run lore check 0 errors, typecheck clean, biome clean on the changed files.
